aces.charge_note: one H100, 8 cores and 39 GB are charged 136 SUs per hour (rule tamu-aces-cluster-slurm.md); a job that runs its whole 24 hours costs 3,264 SUs
job_setup_lines: # TAMU ACES. A unit downloads nothing (MuJoCo Warp compiles its kernels on the node), so the module
# WebProxy/0000 is not loaded. The kernels go to the job's own folder on the node: the scheduler sets
# TMPDIR to /tmp/job.<job id>. The line printed next shows what the login shell brought with it.
echo "TMPDIR=${TMPDIR:-not set}; WARP_CACHE_PATH=$WARP_CACHE_PATH; LD_LIBRARY_PATH before it is cleared: ${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-not set}; modules: $(module -t list 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ')"
